description: Rothco’s Jumbo Canvas Tool Bag offers a robust solution for storing and transporting your essential tools and gear. Crafted from rugged unwashed cotton canvas with a hard bottom shell for durability. The spacious main compartment features 12 interior tool pouches for efficient organization. 2 external snap closure compartments provide additional storage options. In addition, the secure brass zipper closure ensures the safety of your tools during transportation. This tool bag is equipped with sturdy carry handles for easy portability. The heavy-duty canvas bag is great for mechanics, plumbers, electricians, and anyone needing ample tool storage.
